an4.240:1.1: catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye
an4.240:1.3: sabyāpajjhena kāyakammena sabyāpajjhena vacīkammena sabyāpajjhena manokammena sabyāpajjhāya diṭṭhiyā
an4.240:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an4.240:2.1: catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge
an4.240:2.3: abyāpajjhena kāyakammena abyāpajjhena vacīkammena abyāpajjhena manokammena abyāpajjhāya diṭṭhiyā
an4.240:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ saggeti.
